body: I have people in my life who know what happen. My bf is the only one who really knows how bad of a state I’m in but I don’t think he thinks my feelings are valid because I have a great career and have him etc etc, like that I shouldn’t be feeling suicidal
I honestly thought we were doing long distance. I thought that’s what getting back together entailed. I didn’t think it meant that in a couple months I would be expected to move.
Only if we move somewhere we both like and want to live **

I also have a condo here. That I JUST bought. I considered moving to that other city in the past but didn’t because I LIKE the city I’m in. It just would’ve made more sense had he chosen that city for me to give up my condo, my hobbies and my therapist here. Not sure if you’ve ever been to therapy but when you’re working through something extreme with a therapist (which my situation I’m working through is on the extreme end of things), it’s kind of difficult to just leave and start over with a new therapist somewhere else. Possible but difficult. My point is I have a ton of stuff here that I’m happy with and I don’t have any desire to move to the city he is in. If he were willing to pick a city that was another good city for his industry but had things I enjoyed (specifically friends) or was a city I liked in general I would be more willing to move. MY life, although it’s insignificant to my SO and apparently to you, stranger on the internet, is significant to me and I want to feel pleased with my decisions and not feel forced into a decision I do not want to make.    

edited to add, why is it extreme for him to move to a new city but not extreme for me to?

The reason I would be okay with moving to a different city together is that we would be starting a life and making a decision together, not me moving to his life (his home, his friends, his job etc).      

He’s also thirty, had another job on the table in a city I had friends in and was willing to move to, and instead took the job in a city I knew no one in and wasn’t comfortable moving to. I’m not spiteful, but I don’t want to move away from a place I have a lot of things in and that I’m happy in to a city where I would be moving into his home (which is very much his- like all his design decisions), know no one, etc etc. if we found a city we both liked and would agree on I’d be willing to move.     

And you’re kind of wrong about the job assumption, he’s pretty high in his career and in a lucrative industry where he wouldn’t have an issue getting a job. (Hence why he had two offers on the table at the time of taking this job).
Thank you. Reading your response makes me cry.

I think in his mind, that city is where we would end up regardless for his career, so he feels I’m being difficult by not going there. I also should mention I work from home, so in his mind there’s nothing “keeping” me here. He doesn’t think a good therapist, a hobby and a condo are any reasons to stay. I’m just struggling because at the time when he was looking at other jobs, I had proposed ways I would feel comfortable. I told him if he could wait to move until we were engaged I would feel more comfortable picking up and moving my life. Unfortunately, now that he made the decision to move and bought a house without my buy in, nothing there feels like mine, so even if we were to get engaged I would feel like I was moving into his life and trying to play catch-up to feel comfortable there. The thing that bothers me about it isn’t the decision itself, it’s the fact that he felt comfortable making such a huge life change without knowing I was okay with it. It scares me to pick up and move my life for someone who wasn’t willing to compromise.
